headline: Anthropic adds Sheets, Whiteboard and Data tools to Claude
summary: Anthropic introduced new Claude Sheets, whiteboard, and data artifact types, moving Claude closer to a productivity suite that competes with offerings from Google and Microsoft.

claims.statement: Anthropic added Claude Sheets, moving to compete with Google and Microsoft's productivity tools.

sources.quote: Anthropic takes on Google and Microsoft with Claude Sheets
Anthropic tiptoes into MS Office territory

claims.statement: Anthropic also introduced a whiteboard app and a data artifact type alongside Sheets.

sources.quote: The company also has a new whiteboard app.
Sheets, Whiteboards, and Data artifact types bring Claude closer to a productivity suite
